title: How to Build a Business Dashboard Without Code (Custom KPIs in an Afternoon)
summary: Tableau starts at $75/user/month. Most teams need a simple dashboard showing their numbers — not an enterprise analytics platform. Here's how to build exactly what you need in an afternoon.
body_markdown: Looker Studio (formerly Google Data Studio) is free and designed for individuals and small teams — it connects to Google products well and works for basic reporting. Looker is a separate enterprise platform starting at $60,000+/year, designed for large data teams who write LookML to model data across complex SQL databases. They share a name but are completely different products. For most teams, neither is the right tool — a custom Blink dashboard costs less and is easier to maintain.
